summary.zh: 在按下瞬间提供短促缩放和明暗反馈，确认输入已被接收。
summary.en: Confirm input immediately with a brief scale and contrast response.

definition.zh: 指针或触摸按下时提供短促视觉反馈，让控件确认已接收到输入。
definition.en: A brief response during pointer or touch activation makes a control acknowledge contact.

description.zh: 控制一次动效完成所需的时间。
description.en: Controls the time required for one motion cycle.

description.zh: 控制激活状态的缩放比例。
description.en: Controls scale in the active state.

description.zh: 控制速度随时间变化的方式。
description.en: Controls how velocity changes over time.

purpose.zh: 在按下瞬间确认输入已被接收，并赋予控件轻微实体感。
purpose.en: Confirm input at press time and give the control a subtle physical response.

frequency.zh: 适合高频按钮和可点击卡片；反馈时长保持在 70–140ms。
frequency.en: Use for frequent buttons and clickable cards, keeping feedback around 70–140ms.

trigger.zh: 由 pointerdown、touchstart、Space 或 Enter 的按下阶段触发。
trigger.en: Trigger on pointerdown, touchstart, or the press phase of Space and Enter.

enterExit.zh: 按下时轻微缩小并提高对比，释放或取消时立即回到稳定态。
enterExit.en: Scale down slightly and increase contrast on press, restoring immediately on release or cancel.

interruptibility.zh: pointercancel、移出目标和重复按键都从当前比例恢复。
interruptibility.en: Pointer cancel, target exit, and repeated key presses restore from the current scale.

gestureRules.zh: 视觉反馈跟随真实按压状态，不能延迟业务动作或扩大误触区域。
gestureRules.en: Tie feedback to the real pressed state without delaying the action or expanding accidental hit areas.

reducedMotion.zh: 取消缩放，仅保留即时颜色、边框或亮度反馈。
reducedMotion.en: Remove scaling and keep an immediate color, border, or luminance response.

reviewNotes.zh: 确保禁用控件没有按压动画。
reviewNotes.en: Ensure disabled controls have no press animation.

reviewNotes.zh: 检查键盘按压与指针按压得到相同反馈。
reviewNotes.en: Match keyboard and pointer press feedback.

summary.zh: 一次提交后，按钮、状态标记和文档状态一起抵达结果。
summary.en: A submission lands across the action, status marker, and document state together.

scene.zh: 产品更新编辑器中的一条已保存状态。
scene.en: A saved state inside a product-update editor.

note.zh: 保存按钮先确认这次点击已被接收。
note.en: The save action acknowledges the click before the result arrives.

summary.zh: 把一项准备完成的更新，收束成一次有明确落点的发布。
summary.en: Resolve a ready update into a release with a clear landing point.

scene.zh: 发布产品更新时的版本面板。
scene.en: A version panel while publishing a product update.

note.zh: 发布按钮先给出动作已接收的反馈。
note.en: The Publish action first acknowledges that the request was received.

summary.zh: 复制成功通过按钮与短提示共同确认，提示轻量离开。
summary.en: Copy success is confirmed through the action and a light, temporary cue.

scene.zh: 项目设置中的公开预览链接。
scene.en: A public preview link in project settings.

note.zh: 复制动作在原按钮上立刻得到确认。
note.en: The copy action is confirmed directly on its original control.

summary.zh: 用户选中一个布局后，边界、勾选和选择摘要同步表达结果。
summary.en: After selecting a layout, its boundary, checkmark, and selection summary express the result together.

scene.zh: 新建项目时选择一个内容布局。
scene.en: Choosing a content layout for a new project.

note.zh: 每个候选卡片先响应点击，再更新选择。
note.en: Each candidate card responds to the click before selection updates.

summary.zh: 在一组可视模板中确定方向，并把下一步操作稳定地接在选择之后。
summary.en: Choose direction from visual templates, then attach the next action steadily to that choice.

scene.zh: 创建新页面时选择一个起始模板。
scene.en: Choosing a starting template when creating a new page.

note.zh: 模板卡片用轻微按压确认选择输入。
note.en: Template cards use a light press response to acknowledge selection input.

summary.zh: 新内容先占住正确位置，再用极小的位移显露出来。
summary.en: New content reserves its correct position, then reveals itself with very small travel.

scene.zh: 设计工具中新增一个标题或强调图层。
scene.en: Adding a title or accent layer inside a design tool.

note.zh: 添加图层按钮先确认这次新增动作。
note.en: The Add layer action first acknowledges the insertion request.

summary.zh: 项目离开后，撤销入口从同一上下文接住用户。
summary.en: After an item leaves, an undo affordance catches the user in the same context.

scene.zh: 任务列表中把一条评审移到归档。
scene.en: Moving a review task to archive from a task list.

note.zh: 归档按钮立即确认移除动作。
note.en: The Archive action immediately acknowledges the removal request.

summary.zh: 发送邀请后，让输入表单自然转化为一个可追踪的待加入成员。
summary.en: After an invite is sent, turn the form naturally into a trackable pending member.

scene.zh: 在项目设置中邀请新的设计协作者。
scene.en: Inviting a new design collaborator from project settings.

note.zh: 发送邀请先确认动作已开始。
note.en: The Invite action first confirms that sending has begun.

summary.zh: 文件抵达后，用进度、可用状态和新资产行交代结果。
summary.en: When a file lands, use progress, availability, and a new asset row to explain the result.

scene.zh: 在素材库里上传一张产品封面。
scene.en: Uploading a product cover in an asset library.

note.zh: 上传按钮在文件处理开始时立即确认输入。
note.en: The upload action immediately acknowledges input when file processing starts.

summary.zh: 调整数量后，把商品行、件数和小计同步为一个即时的购买状态。
summary.en: After quantity changes, synchronize the item row, item count, and subtotal into one immediate purchase state.

scene.zh: 在结账前调整一件团队模板的数量。
scene.en: Adjusting the quantity of a team template before checkout.

note.zh: 加减按钮在每次数量操作时给出立即按压反馈。
note.en: Increment and decrement controls give immediate press feedback for every quantity action.

summary.zh: 提交回复后，让输入区收束为一条带身份和时间的讨论记录。
summary.en: After a reply is submitted, let the input area resolve into a discussion record with identity and time.

scene.zh: 在设计评审中回复一条关于按钮节奏的评论。
scene.en: Replying to a comment about button cadence in a design review.

note.zh: 回复按钮在发送开始时确认这次提交。
note.en: The Reply action confirms the submission when sending begins.

summary.zh: 发起审批时，让提交动作、审批人队列和当前等待状态形成连续工作流。
summary.en: When approval is requested, connect submission, the approver queue, and the current waiting state into one workflow.

scene.zh: 把一份发布说明提交给两位审批人。
scene.en: Submitting release notes to two approvers.

note.zh: 请求审批按钮先确认提交已经开始。
note.en: The approval-request action first confirms that submission has started.

summary.zh: 付款提交后，用处理中状态和收据结果缩短支付流程的不确定感。
summary.en: After payment is submitted, use a processing state and receipt result to reduce uncertainty in checkout.

scene.zh: 为团队购买一份动效评审模板。
scene.en: Buying a motion-review template for a team.

note.zh: 支付按钮在请求开始时确认点击已接收。
note.en: The payment action acknowledges the click when the request starts.

summary.zh: 为未来发布设置时间后，让发布时间、队列记录和可编辑状态彼此一致。
summary.en: After scheduling a future release, keep publish time, queue record, and editable state consistent.

scene.zh: 为一篇产品更新安排下周一上午发布。
scene.en: Scheduling a product update for Monday morning.

note.zh: 安排发布按钮先确认提交日程的动作。
note.en: The schedule action first confirms the scheduling request.
